SELECT SUM(l.l_extendedprice * (1 - l.l_discount)) AS revenue, c.c_nationkey
FROM (
    UNION ALL (
        SELECT l_orderkey, l_partkey, l_suppkey, l_linenumber, l_quantity, l_extendedprice, l_discount, l_tax, l_returnflag, l_linestatus, l_shipdate, l_commitdate, l_receiptdate, l_shipinstruct, l_shipmode, l_comment
        FROM lineitem
        WHERE l_shipdate >= '1994-01-01' AND l_shipdate < '1995-01-01'
    ), (
        SELECT l_orderkey, l_partkey, l_suppkey, l_linenumber, l_quantity, l_extendedprice, l_discount, l_tax, l_returnflag, l_linestatus, l_shipdate, l_commitdate, l_receiptdate, l_shipinstruct, l_shipmode, l_comment
        FROM lineitem
        WHERE l_shipdate >= '1995-01-01' AND l_shipdate < '1996-01-01'
    )
) l
JOIN customer c ON l.l_orderkey = c.c_custkey
GROUP BY c.c_nationkey;

SELECT SUM(l.l_extendedprice * (1 - l.l_discount)) AS revenue, c.c_nationkey
FROM (
    UNION ALL (
        SELECT l_orderkey, l_partkey, l_suppkey, l_linenumber, l_quantity, l_extendedprice, l_discount, l_tax, l_returnflag, l_linestatus, l_shipdate, l_commitdate, l_receiptdate, l_shipinstruct, l_shipmode, l_comment
        FROM lineitem
        WHERE l_shipdate >= '1994-01-01' AND l_shipdate < '1995-01-01'
    ), (
        SELECT l_orderkey, l_partkey, l_suppkey, l_linenumber, l_quantity, l_extendedprice, l_discount, l_tax, l_returnflag, l_linestatus, l_shipdate, l_commitdate, l_receiptdate, l_shipinstruct, l_shipmode, l_comment
        FROM lineitem
        WHERE l_shipdate >= '1995-01-01' AND l_shipdate < '1996-01-01'
    )
) l
JOIN customer c ON l.l_orderkey = c.c_custkey
GROUP BY c.c_nationkey;

SELECT SUM(l.l_extendedprice * (1 - l.l_discount)) AS revenue, c.c_nationkey
FROM (
    UNION ALL (
        SELECT l_orderkey, l_partkey, l_suppkey, l_linenumber, l_quantity, l_extendedprice, l_discount, l_tax, l_returnflag, l_linestatus, l_shipdate, l_commitdate, l_receiptdate, l_shipinstruct, l_shipmode, l_comment
        FROM lineitem
        WHERE l_shipdate >= '1994-01-01' AND l_shipdate < '1995-01-01'
    ), (

SELECT SUM(l.l_extendedprice * (1 - l.l_discount)) AS revenue, c.c_nationkey
FROM (
    UNION ALL (
        SELECT l_orderkey, l_partkey, l_suppkey, l_linenumber, l_quantity, l_extendedprice, l_discount, l_tax, l_returnflag, l_linestatus, l_shipdate, l_commitdate, l_receiptdate, l_shipinstruct, l_shipmode, l_comment
        FROM lineitem
        WHERE l_shipdate >= '1995-01-01' AND l_shipdate < '1996-01-01'
    ), (
        SELECT l_orderkey, l_partkey, l_suppkey, l_linenumber, l_quantity, l_extendedprice, l_discount, l_tax, l_returnflag, l_linestatus, l_shipdate, l_commitdate, l_receiptdate, l_shipinstruct, l_shipmode, l_comment
        FROM lineitem
        WHERE l_shipdate >= '1996-01-01' AND l_shipdate < '1997-01-01'
    )
) l
JOIN customer c ON l.l_orderkey = c.c_custkey
GROUP BY c.c_nationkey;

SELECT SUM(l.l_extendedprice * (1 - l.l_discount)) AS revenue, c.c_nationkey
FROM (
    UNION ALL (
        SELECT l_orderkey, l_partkey, l_suppkey, l_linenumber, l_quantity, l_extendedprice, l_discount, l_tax, l_returnflag, l_linestatus, l_shipdate, l_commitdate, l_receiptdate, l_shipinstruct, l_shipmode, l_comment
        FROM lineitem
        WHERE l_shipdate >= '1995-01-01' AND l_shipdate < '1996-01-01'
    ), (
        SELECT l_orderkey, l_partkey, l_suppkey, l_linenumber, l_quantity, l_extendedprice, l_discount, l_tax, l_returnflag, l_linestatus, l_shipdate, l_commitdate, l_receiptdate, l_shipinstruct, l_shipmode, l_comment
        FROM lineitem
        WHERE l_shipdate >= '1996-01-01' AND l_shipdate < '1997-01-01'
    )
) l
JOIN customer c ON l.l_orderkey = c.c_custkey
GROUP BY c.c_nationkey;

SELECT SUM(l.l_extendedprice * (1 - l.l_discount)) AS revenue, c.c_nationkey
FROM (
    UNION ALL (
        SELECT l_orderkey, l_partkey, l_suppkey, l_linenumber, l_quantity, l_extendedprice, l_discount, l_tax, l_returnflag, l_linestatus, l_shipdate, l_commitdate, l_receiptdate, l_shipinstruct, l_shipmode, l_comment
        FROM lineitem
        WHERE l_shipdate >= '1995-01-01' AND l_shipdate < '1996-01-01'
    ), (
        SELECT l_orderkey, l_partkey, l_suppkey, l_linenumber, l_quantity, l_extendedprice, l_discount, l_tax, l_returnflag, l_linestatus, l_shipdate, l_commitdate, l_receiptdate, l_shipinstruct, l_shipmode, l_comment
        FROM lineitem
        WHERE l_shipdate >= '1996-01-01' AND l_shipdate < '1997-01-01'
    )
) l
JOIN customer c ON l.l_orderkey = c.c_custkey
GROUP BY c.c_nationkey;

SELECT SUM(l.l_extendedprice * (1 - l.l_discount)) AS revenue, c.c_nationkey
FROM (
    UNION ALL
    SELECT l_orderkey, l_partkey, l_suppkey, l_linenumber, l_quantity, l_extendedprice, l_discount, l_tax, l_returnflag, l_linestatus, l_shipdate, l_commitdate, l_receiptdate, l_shipinstruct, l_shipmode, l_comment
    FROM lineitem WHERE l_shipdate >= '1994-01-01' AND l_shipdate < '1995-01-01',
    SELECT l_orderkey, l_partkey, l_suppkey, l_linenumber, l_quantity, l_extendedprice, l_discount, l_tax, l_returnflag, l_linestatus, l_shipdate, l_commitdate, l_receiptdate, l_shipinstruct, l_shipmode, l_comment
    FROM lineitem WHERE l_shipdate >= '1995-01-01' AND l_shipdate < '1996-01-01'
) l
JOIN customer c ON l.l_orderkey = c.c_custkey
GROUP BY c.c_nationkey;

SELECT SUM(l.l_extendedprice * (1 - l.l_discount)) AS revenue, c.c_nationkey
FROM (
    UNION ALL
    SELECT l_orderkey, l_partkey, l_suppkey, l_linenumber, l_quantity, l_extendedprice, l_discount, l_tax, l_returnflag, l_linestatus, l_shipdate, l_commitdate, l_receiptdate, l_shipinstruct, l_shipmode, l_comment
    FROM lineitem WHERE l_shipdate >= '1994-01-01' AND l_shipdate < '1995-01-01',
    SELECT l_orderkey, l_partkey, l_suppkey, l_linenumber, l_quantity, l_extendedprice, l_discount, l_tax, l_returnflag, l_linestatus, l_shipdate, l_commitdate, l_receiptdate, l_shipinstruct, l_shipmode, l_comment
    FROM lineitem WHERE l_shipdate >= '1995-01-01' AND l_shipdate < '1996-01-01'
) l
JOIN customer c ON l.l_orderkey = c.c_custkey
GROUP BY c.c_nationkey;

SELECT SUM(l.l_extendedprice * (1 - l.l_discount)) AS revenue, c.c_nationkey
FROM (
    UNION ALL
    SELECT l_orderkey, l_partkey, l_suppkey, l_linenumber, l_quantity, l_extendedprice, l_discount, l_tax, l_returnflag, l_linestatus, l_shipdate, l_commitdate, l_receiptdate, l_shipinstruct, l_shipmode, l_comment
    FROM lineitem WHERE l_shipdate >= '1994-01-01' AND l_shipdate < '1995-01-01',
    SELECT l_orderkey, l_partkey, l_suppkey, l_linenumber, l_quantity, l_extendedprice, l_discount, l_tax, l_returnflag, l_linestatus, l_shipdate, l_commitdate, l_receiptdate, l_shipinstruct, l_shipmode, l_comment
    FROM lineitem WHERE l_shipdate >= '1995-01-01' AND l_shipdate < '1996-01-01'
) l
JOIN customer c ON l.l_orderkey = c.c_custkey
GROUP BY c.c_nationkey;

SELECT SUM(l.l_extendedprice * (1 - l.l_discount)) AS revenue, c.c_nationkey
FROM (
    UNION ALL
    SELECT l_orderkey, l_partkey, l_suppkey, l_linenumber, l_quantity, l_extendedprice, l_discount, l_tax, l_returnflag, l_linestatus, l_shipdate, l_commitdate, l_receiptdate, l_shipinstruct, l_shipmode, l_comment
    FROM lineitem WHERE l_shipdate >= '1994-01-01' AND l_shipdate < '1995-01-01',
    SELECT l_orderkey, l_partkey, l_suppkey, l_linenumber, l_quantity, l_extendedprice, l_discount, l_tax, l_returnflag, l_linestatus, l_shipdate, l_commitdate, l_receiptdate, l_shipinstruct, l_shipmode, l_comment
    FROM lineitem WHERE l_shipdate >= '1995-01-01' AND l_shipdate < '1996-01-01'
) l
JOIN customer c ON l.l_orderkey = c.c_custkey
GROUP BY c.c_nationkey;

SELECT SUM(l.l_extendedprice * (1 - l.l_discount)) AS revenue, c.c_nationkey
FROM (
    UNION ALL (
        SELECT l_orderkey, l_partkey, l_suppkey, l_linenumber, l_quantity, l_extendedprice, l_discount, l_tax, l_returnflag, l_linestatus, l_shipdate, l_commitdate, l_receiptdate, l_shipinstruct, l_shipmode, l_comment
        FROM lineitem
        WHERE l_shipdate >= '1995-01-01' AND l_shipdate < '1996-01-01'
    ), (
        SELECT l_orderkey, l_partkey, l_suppkey, l_linenumber, l_quantity, l_extendedprice, l_discount, l_tax, l_returnflag, l_linestatus, l_shipdate, l_commitdate, l_receiptdate, l_shipinstruct, l_shipmode, l_comment
        FROM lineitem
        WHERE l_shipdate >= '1996-01-01' AND l_shipdate < '1997-01-01'
    )
) l
JOIN customer c ON l.l_orderkey = c.c_custkey
GROUP BY c.c_nationkey;

SELECT SUM(l.l_extendedprice * (1 - l.l_discount)) AS revenue, c.c_nationkey
FROM (
    UNION ALL (
        SELECT l_orderkey, l_partkey, l_suppkey, l_linenumber, l_quantity, l_extendedprice, l_discount, l_tax, l_returnflag, l_linestatus, l_shipdate, l_commitdate, l_receiptdate, l_shipinstruct, l_shipmode, l_comment
        FROM lineitem
        WHERE l_shipdate >= '1995-01-01' AND l_shipdate < '1996-01-01'
    ), (
        SELECT l_orderkey, l_partkey, l_suppkey, l_linenumber, l_quantity, l_extendedprice, l_discount, l_tax, l_returnflag, l_linestatus, l_shipdate, l_commitdate, l_receiptdate, l_shipinstruct, l_shipmode, l_comment
        FROM lineitem
        WHERE l_shipdate >= '1996-01-01' AND l_shipdate < '1997-01-01'
    )
) l
JOIN customer c ON l.l_orderkey = c.c_custkey
GROUP BY c.c_nationkey;

SELECT SUM(l.l_extendedprice * (1 - l.l_discount)) AS revenue, c.c_nationkey
FROM (
    UNION ALL (
        SELECT l_orderkey, l_partkey, l_suppkey, l_linenumber, l_quantity, l_extendedprice, l_discount, l_tax, l_returnflag, l_linestatus, l_shipdate, l_commitdate, l_receiptdate, l_shipinstruct, l_shipmode, l_comment
        FROM lineitem
        WHERE l_shipdate >= '1995-01-01' AND l_shipdate < '1996-01-01'
    ), (
        SELECT l_orderkey, l_partkey, l_suppkey, l_linenumber, l_quantity, l_extendedprice, l_discount, l_tax, l_returnflag, l_linestatus, l_shipdate, l_commitdate, l_receiptdate, l_shipinstruct, l_shipmode, l_comment
        FROM lineitem
        WHERE l_shipdate >= '1996-01-01' AND l_shipdate < '1997-01-01'
    )
) l
JOIN customer c ON l.l_orderkey = c.c_custkey
GROUP BY c.c_nationkey;

FROM (
    UNION ALL
    SELECT l_orderkey, l_partkey, l_suppkey, l_linenumber, l_quantity, l_extendedprice, l_discount, l_tax, l_returnflag, l_linestatus, l_shipdate, l_commitdate, l_receiptdate, l_shipinstruct, l_shipmode, l_comment
    FROM lineitem WHERE l_shipdate >= '1994-01-01' AND l_shipdate < '1995-01-01',
    SELECT l_orderkey, l_partkey, l_suppkey, l_linenumber, l_quantity, l_extendedprice, l_discount, l_tax, l_returnflag, l_linestatus, l_shipdate, l_commitdate, l_receiptdate, l_shipinstruct, l_shipmode, l_comment
    FROM lineitem WHERE l_shipdate >= '1995-01-01' AND l_shipdate < '1996-01-01'
) l
JOIN customer c ON l.l_orderkey = c.c_custkey
GROUP BY c.c_nationkey;

SELECT SUM(l.l_extendedprice * (1 - l.l_discount)) AS revenue, c.c_nationkey
FROM (
    UNION ALL
    SELECT l_orderkey, l_partkey, l_suppkey, l_linenumber, l_quantity, l_extendedprice, l_discount, l_tax, l_returnflag, l_linestatus, l_shipdate, l_commitdate, l_receiptdate, l_shipinstruct, l_shipmode, l_comment
    FROM lineitem WHERE l_shipdate >= '1994-01-01' AND l_shipdate < '1995-01-01',
    SELECT l_orderkey, l_partkey, l_suppkey, l_linenumber, l_quantity, l_extendedprice, l_discount, l_tax, l_returnflag, l_linestatus, l_shipdate, l_commitdate, l_receiptdate, l_shipinstruct, l_shipmode, l_comment
    FROM lineitem WHERE l_shipdate >= '1995-01-01' AND l_shipdate < '1996-01-01'
) l
JOIN customer c ON l.l_orderkey = c.c_custkey
GROUP BY c.c_nationkey;

SELECT SUM(l.l_extendedprice * (1 - l.l_discount)) AS revenue, c.c_nationkey
FROM lineitem l
JOIN orders o ON l.l_orderkey = o.o_orderkey
JOIN customer c ON o.o_custkey = c.c_custkey
JOIN nation n ON c.c_nationkey = n.n_nationkey
WHERE l.l_shipdate >= '1994-01-01' AND l.l_shipdate < '1995-01-01'
GROUP BY c.c_nationkey
UNION ALL
SELECT 0 AS revenue, 1 AS c_nationkey
WHERE FALSE;

SELECT SUM(l.l_extendedprice * (1 - l.l_discount)) AS revenue, c.c_nationkey
FROM lineitem l
JOIN orders o ON l.l_orderkey = o.o_orderkey
JOIN customer c ON o.o_custkey = c.c_custkey
JOIN nation n ON c.c_nationkey = n.n_nationkey
WHERE l.l_shipdate >= '1994-01-01' AND l.l_shipdate < '1995-01-01'
GROUP BY c.c_nationkey
UNION ALL
SELECT 0 AS revenue, 1 AS c_nationkey
WHERE FALSE;

SELECT SUM(l.l_extendedprice * (1 - l.l_discount)) AS revenue, c.c_nationkey
FROM lineitem l
JOIN orders o ON l.l_orderkey = o.o_orderkey
JOIN customer c ON o.o_custkey = c.c_custkey
JOIN nation n1 ON c.c_nationkey = n1.n_nationkey
JOIN region r ON n1.n_regionkey = r.r_regionkey
JOIN (
    SELECT s.s_suppkey, SUM(ps.ps_supplycost * ps.ps_availqty) AS total_supplycost
    FROM partsupp ps
    JOIN supplier s ON ps.ps_suppkey = s.s_suppkey
    GROUP BY s.s_suppkey
) sub ON l.l_suppkey = sub.s_suppkey
WHERE r.r_name = 'AMERICA' AND o.o_orderdate >= '1994-01-01' AND o.o_orderdate < '1995-01-01'
GROUP BY c.c_nationkey
UNION ALL
SELECT 0 AS revenue, 0 AS c_nationkey
WHERE NOT EXISTS (
    SELECT 1
    FROM lineitem l
    JOIN orders o ON l.l_orderkey = o.o_orderkey
    JOIN customer c ON o.o_custkey = c.c_custkey
    JOIN nation n1 ON c.c_nationkey = n1.n_nationkey
    JOIN region r ON n1.n_regionkey = r.r_regionkey

SELECT SUM(l.l_extendedprice * (1 - l.l_discount)) AS revenue, c.c_nationkey
FROM lineitem l
JOIN orders o ON l.l_orderkey = o.o_orderkey
JOIN customer c ON o.o_custkey = c.c_custkey
JOIN nation n1 ON c.c_nationkey = n1.n_nationkey
JOIN region r ON n1.n_regionkey = r.r_regionkey
JOIN (
    SELECT s.s_suppkey, SUM(ps.ps_supplycost * ps.ps_availqty) AS total_supplycost
    FROM partsupp ps
    JOIN supplier s ON ps.ps_suppkey = s.s_suppkey
    GROUP BY s.s_suppkey
) sub ON l.l_suppkey = sub.s_suppkey
WHERE r.r_name = 'AMERICA' AND o.o_orderdate >= '1994-01-01' AND o.o_orderdate < '1995-01-01'
GROUP BY c.c_nationkey
UNION ALL
SELECT 0 AS revenue, 0 AS c_nationkey
WHERE NOT EXISTS (
    SELECT 1
    FROM lineitem l
    JOIN orders o ON l.l_orderkey = o.o_orderkey
    JOIN customer c ON o.o_custkey = c.c_custkey
    JOIN nation n1 ON c.c_nationkey = n1.n_nationkey
    JOIN region r ON n1.n_regionkey = r.r_regionkey
    WHERE r.r_name = 'AMERICA' AND o.o_orderdate >= '1994-01-01' AND o.o_orderdate < '1995-01-01'
);

SELECT SUM(l.l_extendedprice * (1 - l.l_discount)) AS revenue, c.c_nationkey
FROM lineitem l
JOIN orders o ON l.l_orderkey = o.o_orderkey
JOIN customer c ON o.o_custkey = c.c_custkey
JOIN nation n1 ON c.c_nationkey = n1.n_nationkey
JOIN region r ON n1.n_regionkey = r.r_regionkey
JOIN (
    SELECT s.s_suppkey, SUM(ps.ps_supplycost * ps.ps_availqty) AS total_supplycost
    FROM partsupp ps
    JOIN supplier s ON ps.ps_suppkey = s.s_suppkey
    GROUP BY s.s_suppkey
) sub ON l.l_suppkey = sub.s_suppkey
WHERE r.r_name = 'AMERICA' AND o.o_orderdate >= '1994-01-01' AND o.o_orderdate < '1995-01-01'
GROUP BY c.c_nationkey
UNION ALL
SELECT 0 AS revenue, 0 AS c_nationkey
WHERE NOT EXISTS (
    SELECT 1
    FROM lineitem l
    JOIN orders o ON l.l_orderkey = o.o_orderkey
    JOIN customer c ON o.o_custkey = c.c_custkey
    JOIN nation n1 ON c.c_nationkey = n1.n_nationkey
    JOIN region r ON n1.n_regionkey = r.r_regionkey
    WHERE r.r_name = 'AMERICA' AND o.o_orderdate >= '1994-01-01' AND o.o_orderdate < '1995-01-01'
);

SELECT SUM(l.l_extendedprice * (1 - l.l_discount)) AS revenue, c.c_nationkey
FROM (
    UNION ALL
    SELECT l_orderkey, l_partkey, l_suppkey, l_linenumber, l_quantity, l_extendedprice, l_discount, l_tax, l_returnflag, l_linestatus, l_shipdate, l_commitdate, l_receiptdate, l_shipinstruct, l_shipmode, l_comment
    FROM lineitem WHERE l_shipdate >= '1995-01-01' AND l_shipdate < '1996-01-01',
    SELECT l_orderkey, l_partkey, l_suppkey, l_linenumber, l_quantity, l_extendedprice, l_discount, l_tax, l_returnflag, l_linestatus, l_shipdate, l_commitdate, l_receiptdate, l_shipinstruct, l_shipmode, l_comment
    FROM lineitem WHERE l_shipdate >= '1996-01-01' AND l_shipdate < '1997-01-01'
) l
JOIN customer c ON l.l_orderkey = c.c_custkey
GROUP BY c.c_nationkey;

SELECT SUM(l.l_extendedprice * (1 - l.l_discount)) AS revenue, c.c_nationkey
FROM (
    UNION ALL
    SELECT l_orderkey, l_partkey, l_suppkey, l_linenumber, l_quantity, l_extendedprice, l_discount, l_tax, l_returnflag, l_linestatus, l_shipdate, l_commitdate, l_receiptdate, l_shipinstruct, l_shipmode, l_comment
    FROM lineitem WHERE l_shipdate >= '1995-01-01' AND l_shipdate < '1996-01-01',
    SELECT l_orderkey, l_partkey, l_suppkey, l_linenumber, l_quantity, l_extendedprice, l_discount, l_tax, l_returnflag, l_linestatus, l_shipdate, l_commitdate, l_receiptdate, l_shipinstruct, l_shipmode, l_comment
    FROM lineitem WHERE l_shipdate >= '1996-01-01' AND l_shipdate < '1997-01-01'
) l
JOIN customer c ON l.l_orderkey = c.c_custkey
GROUP BY c.c_nationkey;
